one_liner: White‑label payment gateway (likely on NMI) for accepting payments and managing merchants; developers authenticate with NMI security keys and use NMI’s payment APIs/webhooks.
access_notes: merchants are onboarded via a reseller/partner; credentials come after account setup
blocker_notes: Plan gating: In practice, keys are issued after merchant onboarding with Paygent (the reseller) and/or processor approval.

evidence.quote: NMI operates exclusively through a partner channel. We don’t directly onboard individual merchants as end users.
Authentication across our APIs is done via secure API keys.
From the Merchant Portal, Settings > Webhooks page, click the ‘Create’ button.
The payment gateway’s real-time v4 API is a complete API that allows you to build any payment features found in your NMI Partner Portal.
POST /api/transact.php … security_key* | API Security Key assigned to a merchant account.
